ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 26.23. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 44 · daily cycle day 33).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): counter-trend bounce. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Daily momentum ~1 bars from turning up
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Counter-trend bounce inside a bearish bigger picture. For nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 26.23. If the daily low fails it cascades toward the larger cycle low; not an investment buy.
entry.text_zh: 处于看空大局中的逆势反弹。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 26.23 下方。若日线低点失守，将向更大周期低点蔓延；并非投资性买入。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 33 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: approaching the window where lows usually form
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 33 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 接近低点通常形成的时间窗口
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 44 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 44 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、将止损紧贴 26.23 下方。并非投资性买入；在采信之前，请等待周线周期真正转向上行（或出现新的投资者周期低点予以确认）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 44 周 · 日线周期第 33 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：逆势反弹。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响

ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A HIGH). Signal strength: mild (score -35/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 逆势反弹信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近高点翻转）。 信号强度：温和（评分 -35/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱高风险反弹（+30）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✓ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
